Auth.guideDescription: Learn how to sign up and use the service without logging in.
Auth.registerDescription: Verify your email first, then create your account.
Auth.passwordHint: Use at least 8 characters. Letters and digits can be up to 72 characters; Korean characters, emoji, and other characters may have a lower limit.
Auth.nicknameHint: Up to 30 characters. You can use the same nickname as someone else.
Auth.birthDateHint: Enter your actual date of birth. It is not shared with other users.
Auth.registered: Your account is ready. Log in with your email and password.
Auth.codeSent: Email sent. Check your spam folder too. Time remaining: {seconds}s
Auth.codeExpired: Verification has expired. Request a new code.
Auth.accountDescription: Manage the ways you can log in to your TranslaCat account.
Auth.linkGoogleDescription: Verify your current password, then select the Google account with the email shown above. Your existing account and data will be kept.
Auth.googleAvailable: You can log in with your linked Google account.
Auth.googleLinkedSuccess: Google account linked. Both login methods now open the same account.
Auth.passwordAvailable: You can log in with your email and password.
Auth.addPasswordDescription: Verify your Google account and email, then set a password.
Auth.reauthenticated: Google account verified. Complete email verification and set your password within 5 minutes.
Auth.passwordAdded: Password set. You can now log in with Google or your email and password.

errors.AUTH_PASSWORD_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED: Too many password verification attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.AUTH_UNAVAILABLE: Your request cannot be processed right now. Try again shortly.
errors.AUTH_PASSWORD_INVALID: Your password must have at least 8 characters and be no more than 72 bytes in UTF-8.
errors.AUTH_BIRTH_DATE_INVALID: Enter your actual date of birth. It cannot be in the future.
errors.AUTH_MAIL_UNAVAILABLE: Email verification is not ready yet. Try again shortly.
errors.AUTH_MAIL_SEND_FAILED: The verification email could not be sent. Try again shortly.
errors.AUTH_EMAIL_ALREADY_EXISTS: This email is already registered. Log in using your existing method, then add another method in Account and login.
errors.AUTH_ACCOUNT_LINK_REQUIRED: An account already uses this email. Log in with your existing password, then link Google in Account and login.
errors.AUTH_GOOGLE_LINK_REQUIRED: Log in to your existing email account, then link Google in Account and login.
errors.AUTH_REQUIRED: You need to log in. Please log in again.
errors.INVALID_REQUEST: The request could not be verified. Refresh the page.
errors.REAUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: Verification has expired. Verify your Google account again.
errors.GOOGLE_FLOW_EXPIRED: Google verification expired or your login session changed. Start again.
errors.GOOGLE_FLOW_FAILED: Google verification was canceled or failed. Try again.
errors.AUTH_GOOGLE_EMAIL_MISMATCH: Select a Google account with the same email as your current account.
errors.AUTH_GOOGLE_ALREADY_LINKED: This Google account is already linked to another account.
errors.AUTH_PASSWORD_ALREADY_SET: A password has already been set.
errors.AUTH_EMAIL_VERIFICATION_EXPIRED: Email verification has expired. Request a new code.
errors.AUTH_EMAIL_RATE_LIMITED: Too many verification requests. Try again shortly.
